speaker: Guest
gloss: Good afternoon. I have a booking under the name Jones.

text: Bore da. Dw i ddim yn… teimlo'n grêt —… fedrwch chi argymell rhywbeth?
speaker: Customer
gloss: Good morning. I'm not feeling great - could you recommend something?

text: Dw i wedi cael cur pen… a gwddw drwg ers ddoe.
speaker: Customer
gloss: I've had a headache and a sore throat since yesterday.

text: Pa mor aml ddylwn i gymryd… y parasetamol?
speaker: Customer
gloss: How often should I take the paracetamol?

text: Ydi hi'n iawn… i'w cymryd efo bwyd?
speaker: Customer
gloss: Are they all right to take with food?

text: Medra, wrth gwrs. Falla bydd o'n cymryd… dipyn o amser,… mae 'na lot o draffig… ar hyn o bryd.
speaker: Driver
gloss: Yes, of course. It may take some time, there's a lot of traffic at the moment.
